name: Shirabe Research
description: Shirabe Research is a quiet, editorial WordPress theme designed for qualitative research practices, advisory consultancies, and independent studios. Featuring a framed-window hero, serif typography, and structured ledger layouts, it presents case studies, fieldwork methodologies, and transparent fee tables with calm clarity. Built with block editor support, elegant motion tokens, and clean monochrome palettes.

fonts.role: display: headings, titles, figures (Regular and Italic; Latin)

summary.en: A market research practice: split headline row, a framed interview window that opens into an ink band, uppercase serif titles and giant figures.
